title: Trail notes for the weekend
author: Abdur Nur Porag
body: The forest path was quiet and the light came through the canopy in long green stripes. We walked the lower loop first, then climbed to the ridge where the view opens over the valley. Bring water, wear good boots, and leave nothing behind. More details and photos will follow in the next update.
